设计意图： Mutation of factor_downside_volatility_ratio: extends the lookback window from 20 to 40 days to reduce noise and improve stability of the downside asymmetry measure. The longer window provides a smoother estimate of the leverage effect, targeting improved RankIC and ICIR while preserving the core economic mechanism.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(divide(ts_std(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), ), 40), ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 40)), 0.5)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_std(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), ), 40), ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 40))
  3. 3. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), ), 40)
  4. 4. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), )
  5. 5. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  6. 6. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  7. 7. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 40)
  8. 8. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  3. 计算 neg_ret：ret.where(ret < 0, 0.0)
  4. 计算 window：40
  5. 计算 down_vol：neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
  6. 计算 total_vol：ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
  7. 计算 total_vol_safe：total_vol
  8. 计算 factor：down_vol / total_vol_safe
  9. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_volatility_ratio_long(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] ret = close.pct_change() neg_ret = ret.where(ret < 0, 0.0) window = 40 down_vol = neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1) total_vol = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1) total_vol_safe = total_vol.replace(0, np.nan) factor = down_vol / total_vol_safe factor = factor.fillna(0.5) df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_ratio_long"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_downside_volatility_ratio_long"]
